Title: A Day to Remember

Cast

1. Ishaan - 10 years, son
Look: red T-shirt, jeans
2. Anita - 38 years, mother
Look: yellow kurta, jeans
3. Sharda - 64 years, grandmother
Look: pale blue saree, white hair

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Ishaan stands in the courtyard. Anita and Sharda stand near him.]

Sharda: "Today feels like a good day."

[Ishaan dances to the music.]

Ishaan: "Show me too!"

[Ishaan scratches his head.]

Sharda: "What happened?"

[Ishaan whispers something to Mother.]

Ishaan: "I knew it!"

[Ishaan gives Mother a flower.]

Sharda: "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
